text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Did I win...? Did I really just go and win 
the Japanese Derby...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh... Guess the Big Guy upstairs is on 
my side after all. Even though He totally 
abandoned me when I was a kid...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Nothin' could make me happier than this... 
Nothin'... at least, that's how it should 
be. My family'll be thrilled with this, 
too...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: And yet, why is this happening...? Why...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I... actually won, didn't I? The 
"Japanese Derby", even all battered and 
bruised like this.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Still, even so... More than feeling happy, 
I just...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm just relieved... That even while 
shaking in my boots watching the other 
Umamusume, I still managed to win.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even though I pulled off something 
amazing... I'm so pathetic... It's just 
pathetic, ya know...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to celebrate like a total idiot, 
you know? It was my only Derby. Heheh... 
hehehe..."

Tamamo Cross tried to force a smile. Her 
legs were trembling—from excitement, fear, 
and sheer exhaustion.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I shouldn't talk to them right now. 
The atmosphere feels kind of...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Tamamo-senpai. That was 
an amazing run...

A monumental feat achieved while bearing 
deep emotional wounds. Tamamo Cross etched 
her name in history as a Derby Umamusume.
